I will be voting to leave. This is an issue of sovereignty to me. I want this country to govern itself. I believe the House of Commons should be supreme to the European Parliament, and we should be able to veto any law coming from that parliament that we disagree with.

I don't want to be a state in a grand European superstate. I want Britain to be a free and independent country. I believe that the current leaders of the European Union want more federalism; not less. I want a much looser agreement with the other member states. I want trade with Europe, and friendship with Europe, but I don't want to be in a political union with Europe.

I will be voting out, there can be no doubt that the EU has ambitions to become a federal Republic of Europe by the gradual and complete abolition of the national governments. It's fantastic if you're a vast multinational corporation from Germany, not so much if you're a small business from Britain. It's stifling our economy and slowly gutting our democratically elected government, replacing it's functions one by one with unelected bureaucrats directed far more by the ideology of Europeanism (a completely contrived ideology at that, it was a desperate attempt to prevent yet another Franco-German conflict, nothing to do with us) than practicality or the will of the people.
